question: What cosmic range must be encompassed when meditating on that presence in every place?
premises: Meditation is performed in place after place
That presence is the object of meditation
Its range extends from Shiva down to Avici
inference: One should meditate on that presence in every place as pervading the whole range from Shiva to Avici
plain_english: Having meditated on him in place after place, one should contemplate him as ranging from Shiva down to Avici.
